Rafters here (C-150x50x20x3.2mm, 6.76 kg/m) are a visibly heavier section than the lower/porch roof's rafters on S-07 (C-75x45x15x2.3mm, 3.25 kg/m) — consistent with this being the primary roof structure.

Only the grid-anchored purlin rows (A', A, B, C, C') are recorded as atomic elements. Additional intermediate purlins are shown per the '@ไม่เกิน 1.00ม.' spacing rule in both the A-B gap (3.60m, needs further breaks) and the B-C gap (1.80m, needs one further break) — their exact positions are not individually dimensioned on this sheet, so they are described via spacing_mm/note rather than invented grid lines, consistent with S-07's treatment of the same rule.
